title: E-commerce UX & Checkout Optimisation
description: Design friction-free e-commerce flows that drive purchases. Tests cart flows, form validation, trust signals, and guest checkout design.

seo.overviewBody: E-commerce UX directly drives digital revenue by eliminating buying friction. Growth designers demonstrate impact by optimizing Product Detail Pages (PDP), designing slide-out cart drawers, streamlining guest checkout flows, and placing trust signals effectively.

deliverables.title: 1. E-Commerce PDP & Checkout UX Redesign Spec
deliverables.desc: High-fidelity redesign of a Product Detail Page (PDP) and streamlined 3-step checkout flow.

deliverables.title: 2. Guest Checkout Friction Audit Report
deliverables.desc: Friction report identifying forced account creation roadblocks, hidden shipping costs, and field validation issues.

deliverables.title: 3. Mobile Shopping Experience Wireframes
deliverables.desc: Mobile-first e-commerce wireframes featuring sticky add-to-cart bars and one-click express checkout options.

faqs.question: Why is forced account creation a primary cause of cart abandonment?
faqs.answer: Forcing users to register before purchasing adds unnecessary cognitive friction; offering a seamless Guest Checkout option increases conversion rates dramatically.

faqs.question: What essential elements belong on an effective Product Detail Page (PDP)?
faqs.answer: High-res image gallery, clear product title, pricing, stock availability, customer ratings/reviews, variant selectors, sticky Add-to-Cart CTA, and delivery/returns info.

faqs.question: Where should trust signals be placed during checkout?
faqs.answer: Display security trust badges (SSL certificates, secure payment logos) directly adjacent to credit card input fields and the final 'Pay Now' button.
